notes: Between seasons: 2027 draft projections from the seasons before, aged; playing time from the last two seasons and age; clubs from the transactions of the season and since (a free agent is projected with a league-average club).

5x5 values: z-scores over a 12-team mixed league's pool (C, 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, CI, MI, 5 OF, UT; 9 P), AVG, ERA and WHIP weighted by at-bats and innings, minus the replacement level of the player's best position; dollars on a $260 budget (67% hitters).
Positions: 20 games at a position last season (or his most); outfield spots count as OF.
Points: our default scheme, editable on the page; the projections carry every counting stat it uses.

Dynasty: this season's value above replacement times the player's five-season multiplier from valuation v2 (expected WAR over five seasons, discounted, against next season's), plus the best prospects from the minor-league model.

No ADP, ownership or platform rankings: their terms do not allow our use. Rises and falls are against last season's value rank; streaming starters are those outside our top 150 (a proxy for availability).
